play.title: Play requests
play.subtitle: Bilibili-style goods, Stardust, and orders — seeds, challenges, co-op, and on-stream requests only.
play.ticketHint: Stardust is held in escrow, not spent. Auto-refund if the streamer misses the SLA, goes offline, or cancels. No viewer refund after play starts.
play.noAccountHint: Placing an order holds Stardust. Auto-refund if not accepted in 15 min, or not started within 30 min of accept.
play.policyBanner: No rank boosting, boosting services, or account passwords. Streamers play on their own accounts, or both sides log in separately for co-op.
play.emptyGoods: Nothing listed in this category yet.
play.seedPlaceholder: e.g. a Minecraft or Binding of Isaac seed
play.notePlaceholder: What to play, challenge rules, or in-game name. Never share a password.
play.privateHint: Pick a streamer and game first, then a type offered for that game. The submit button shows the Stardust cost.
play.gamePlaceholder: Minecraft / Binding of Isaac / Stardew Valley…
play.emptyOrders: No orders yet. Pick a seed or challenge in the hall.
play.emptyStudio: No orders yet. Place one as a viewer, then come back here to accept it.

str-seed-sower.name: Wheatfield Seeds
str-seed-sower.bio: Minecraft survival starts and seed challenges. Public seeds only; never uses a viewer's account.

str-roguelike-lab.name: Roguelike Lab
str-roguelike-lab.bio: Seeded Binding of Isaac and Slay the Spire runs, talked through live. No ranked boosting.

str-farm-night.name: Evening Breeze Farm
str-farm-night.bio: Stardew Valley co-op farming. Both sides log in on their own accounts and add as friends.

g-mc-seed-survive.title: Minecraft seeded survival start
g-mc-seed-survive.details: You provide the seed. I play about 2 hours on my own world: spawn, building, mining. Watch along — I won't log into your account.

g-mc-challenge.title: Minecraft custom-rules challenge
g-mc-challenge.details: Half-heart, mining-only, village speedrun, and similar rules go in the notes. I complete it live on my own world.

g-isaac-seed.title: Binding of Isaac seeded run
g-isaac-seed.details: I enter the seed and play a run, talking through item choices. No ranked play, no other people's saves.

g-sts-seed.title: Slay the Spire seeded run (character optional)
g-sts-seed.details: I start from your seed. Note whether you want standard or Ascension. Played on my own save.

g-indie-onstream.title: On-stream indie / single-player request
g-indie-onstream.details: Pick a single-player game I own or can buy. No competitive ranked play, no logging into your account.

g-stardew-coop.title: Stardew Valley co-op farming night
g-stardew-coop.details: Add as friends and open a co-op farm. Share your in-game name — never a password.

about.title: About
about.p1: Star Trail Demo is a prototype for sharing artist bios and update timelines with friends. It doesn't represent any artist, agency, or official fan club.
about.p2: Information is compiled from public, checkable sources, and every update includes a source link. If something is wrong or infringes rights, please ask for a correction or removal.
about.li1: No private addresses, travel plans, or family details
about.li2: No fundraising, ranking campaigns, or third-party boosting
about.li3: The play-request demo only covers seeds, challenges, co-op, and on-stream requests — not rank boosting
about.li4: Avatars stay as text or outbound links to avoid hosting images without permission
about.li5: Browsing is free for now; paid memberships would be announced separately
